Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ravi Shanker Jha,
 Chief Justice
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Arun Palli
Present: Mr. Shiv Kumar, Advocate, for the petitioners.

Mr. Ankur Mittal, Addl. Ag, Haryana, and
 Ms. Kushaldeep Kaur, Mr. Shivam Garg, and Mr. Jugam Arora,
 Advocates, for the respondents.

Learned counsel for the petitioners concedes that the issue involved in the present writ petition is squarely covered by a decision of the Supreme Court in Indore Development Authority Vs. Manohar Lal and others, AIR 2020 SC 1496, however, he prays for withdrawal of the petition as the petitioner wants to file an application under Section 101(A) of the Right of Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation, and Resettlement Act, 2013.
